meta.parties: Palaniappa Chettiar Et Al. v. Mercantile Bank

rules.statement: The failure to comply with the matters specified in (2) and (3) above are not fundamental, which does not amount to a substantial default, abating the appeal.
rules.supporting_quote: "In my opinion they are not fundamental. The application in revision is, in these circumstances, allowed and the order of November 28 1941, set aside."
